source: Written for english/y4 lesson 93 (Teacher-written model diary entry 'Day 4: Arizona' (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 93: Reading a road trip diary: first person, past tense and feelings (VIPERS). Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

passage.title: Teacher-written model diary entry for TGA
paras: Today we drove for six hours along Route 66. At first I was bored, staring at the endless red desert. Then Dad stopped at the Petrified Forest. I couldn't believe it: huge tree trunks had turned to stone over millions of years! I ran my hand along one; it was cold and smooth, like glass.
Tonight, as I write this, the stars are brighter than I have ever seen. I feel tiny, but in a good way.

head: Feature
Example
rows: I couldn't believe it; I feel tiny

model.title: What does 'I feel tiny, but in a good way' suggest?

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: The writer feels small compared with the huge sky, which fills them with wonder rather than fear.

keywords.def: a private daily record of events and feelings
one piece of writing in a diary, for one day

questions.q: Core: answer six VIPERS questions on the diary entry
Extend: write three differences between this diary and the postcard from lesson 84
questions.a: For example: past tense vs present; longer; more feelings

questions.q: Stretch: why does the writer begin with being bored?
questions.a: To contrast with the amazement later and make it stronger

questions.q: How did the writer's feelings change during the day?
questions.a: C) from bored to amazed. At first they were bored; at the Petrified Forest they couldn't believe it, which shows amazement.
